Metadata-protocol: none (no spec or REST change expected)
Premise: re-read on main `b113178d` by the card thread: holds. Plan in `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35955/split-plan.md`.
Basis: card #35955, a p2 child of epic #35547, which the maintainer handed to this seat on 2026-11-20 16:32Z; scope widened by the maintainer on 2026-11-21.
Scope: PR 1 = the draft layer and Discard / Save: changes on a list apply at once and are not stored; Save on a personal view stores to it; "Save as my view" asks for a name first (default "VIEW copy"); a toast after saving; the chips stay after saving back. Desktop shows Discard plus Save ▾; narrow widths show one Save that opens three items, in the shared `conditionRowEnd` slot the phone list (#35883) also draws. PR 1 stops reading and writing the draft parts of the server list preference. PR 2 (new session) = "Save to this view" on a shared view, with its confirm and publish, on the same path as #35932. PR 3 (new session) = retiring the server `ui.list` preference for what is left. Seat accepts the thread's readings R1–R5 in the plan (search is draft-lived but lights no buttons and is not saved; a reload clears drafts while a copied link still filters; layout, row colour and inline-edit toggles are drafts; no new kanban stage control; Discard looks like #35892's). Two questions go to the maintainer before PR 2 and PR 3: where column widths live (D1) and whether "Save to this view" on a shared view publishes at once (D2).
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #35678 and #35883 run in parallel threads on overlapping files; `overlap-check.mjs` runs after the first commit and before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Ruling record · 2026-11-21T06:27Z · The maintainer (os-sales) answered the seat's decision card (D2 of the card thread's plan) at 2026-11-21T06:26Z, choosing 「确认后立即对所有人生效」:
- "Save to this view" on a shared view: after the one confirm step ("everyone using this view will see it"), the change is saved and published at once; other users see it on refresh, as this card's acceptance says.
- If the view already has an unpublished draft (for example a footer calculation pick from #35702's flow), Save does not publish that draft on someone's behalf: it says so and points to the view settings to publish or discard it first; the buttons stay.
- This explicit, confirmed Save is the exception to ruling 7045525672 (#35702), whose "toolbar controls never write a shared view directly; changes go to a draft first" still holds for every implicit change.
- Settled earlier by the maintainer and not asked again: column widths, row height and tab order live only in this browser (card body, rewritten after the maintainer's 「只记在浏览器里」).

Applies to PR 2 of this card (claim 7058427316), which is ordered after #35932.
